latestVersion.changelog:
Newsletter Monetization Machine initial release:

- Launches a fully automated system to build, grow, and monetize newsletters in any niche.
- Automatically scrapes top content sources (Google News, Reddit, Twitter/X, LinkedIn), analyzes competitors, and generates four full newsletter editions in your chosen tone.
- Identifies monetization opportunities (sponsors, affiliates, paid products) tailored to your audience and goals.
- Includes video teaser creation for each edition via InVideo AI to drive subscriber growth.
- Delivers a weekly content, growth, and revenue plan—outputted as JSON or Markdown for easy integration.
